text.p: Louisiana-Pacific Corp said Tuesday that it will close its two facilities in El Sauzal, Mexico.

The company said it will close its brick plant December 31 and close its lumber remanufacturing operation January 31. About 200 workers will be affected. All will receive severance pay, the company said.
"A variety of market conditions and cost considerations had led to the decision to close these facilities," the company said in a release."
In November the building products company announced the closing of its window making facility in California and the closings of two oriented strand board plants in Texas and Virginia.
Louisiana-Pacific shares were off 1/8 Tuesday afternoon at 22-5/8.
